Change c0527. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): It was long before he was restored; and I often thought that life was entirely extinct.

1818 text: At length he opened his eyes, but he breathed with difficulty, and was unable to speak.

1831 text: At length he opened his eyes; he breathed with difficulty, and was unable to speak.

Diff: At length he opened his eyes [-, but-] {+;+} he breathed with difficulty, and was unable to speak.

Context after (unchanged): The surgeon gave him a composing draught, and ordered us to leave him undisturbed.

result.rationale: Removal of the conjunction 'but' and replacement with a semicolon, creating two independent clauses. Syntactic/punctuation change with no alteration of meaning or events.
